tools.name: bank_asset_quality_review
tools.description: Cited NPA changes, PCR definitions and capital scope for banks/SFBs/UCBs, plus separately dated provisional business updates when accepted. Keep each period and provisional status explicit. No score, credit or execution authority.

tools.name: bank_npa_reconciliation
tools.description: Reconcile supplied NPA movements; keep recoveries/write-offs/sales/upgrades distinct. Arithmetic, not input authentication.

tools.name: banking_specialisation_coverage
tools.description: Bank/SFB/UCB coverage, stale/missing evidence and co-op census counts. Not a rating.

tools.name: corporate_transmission_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: is US funding stress reaching nonfinancial firms? Use household_credit_board for households. CP, bank credit lines and real-economy confirmation; cannot_see preserves gaps. Seiche context never enters regime or transmission. Display-only; no institution score or tier. full:true

tools.name: crypto_exposure_board
tools.description: Cited bank/crypto exposure register: disclosed quantum, stablecoin and venue links, exposure channels, Undertow run-risk cross-read and compound flags. Details on REST. Display-only, never an institution score or investment advice.

tools.name: crypto_regime_board
tools.description: BTC/ETH Crypto Regime board: change-point state, log-SR statistic, last shift, observation count and display-only cross-read against disclosed bank exposure. Paths on REST. Feeds no institution score; not investment advice.

tools.name: evidence_europe
tools.description: Seven cited European retrospective case files through unrecalibrated Indian lenses. Named case studies, not a cohort: no European recall percentage to quote.

tools.name: evidence_india
tools.description: 48-institution Indian construction-PIT crisis diagnostic, including misses and false alarms. Publication clocks where present, else a +60-day filing-lag proxy; overwritten amendments are unreconstructable. evidence_institution returns a full replay.

tools.name: evidence_institution
tools.description: A sourced Indian construction-PIT quarterly replay, lens alert timing and hit/miss/false-alarm verdict. Slugs from evidence_india. Filing-availability proxies do not establish a validated backtest.

tools.name: evidence_markets
tools.description: Historical evidence: India (48-institution construction-PIT diagnostic), US (industry-wide current-amended vintage), Europe (named cases, no cohort claim). Start here; details in evidence_india, evidence_us or evidence_europe.

tools.name: evidence_us
tools.description: US bank current-amended-vintage diagnostics and named replays, including misses. Not a validated point-in-time backtest. Report the quarterly top-decile budgeted watchlist beside recall, uncertainty and lead times; not an individual-bank verdict.

tools.name: failure_radar_board
tools.description: Vetted Indian lender PDs, PCA/SAF and funding. market_dd requires tier authority; diagnostic clocks/refusals stay in market_dd_evidence. Slugs for failure_radar_institution. Research, not a rating.

tools.name: failure_radar_institution
tools.description: One Indian lender dossier: quarterly PDs and drivers, PCA/SAF headroom, funding, forensic and listed-market evidence. Slugs from failure_radar_board. Uncovered institutions remain absent, never scored from memory.

tools.name: forward_odds
tools.description: Counted Markov transitions and empirical 5/20-day reach odds, withheld until 60 observed days; counts stay visible and absence is never precision. Historical frequencies are not calibrated forecasts. Display-only, never a state driver.

tools.name: household_credit_board
tools.description: Answers ONE question: is stress reaching US household credit? Use corporate_transmission_board for firms. Delinquency, charge-offs, revolving credit and unscored debt-service context; gaps stay in cannot_see. Display-only; no institution score or watchlist tier. full:true adds methods and histories.

tools.name: institution_evidence_monitor
tools.description: Bank/NBFC evidence, gaps and review alerts. slug: one record; slugs: watchlist; neither: all tracked. End-of-day as_of. No scoring or delivery authority.

tools.name: institution_research_coverage
tools.description: Search Indian dossiers, RBI rows or NAFSCOB co-op census. Overlapping populations; listing grants no coverage or score.

tools.name: institution_review_packet
tools.description: Cited human review packet for an exact slug or unique normalized full name. No fuzzy match or new score; stale/dark gaps retained. Content hash detects alteration, not attestation or publication-time proof.

tools.name: latest_article
tools.description: Today's exact full-text LiquiLens editorial: current institution-risk analysis when the evidence moved, else a labelled historical replay. Quote it with its evidence clock and passing publication receipt, without regenerating facts.

tools.name: lending_geography
tools.description: Co-op bank districts (with basis) and CHIRPS rainfall per district. id: in-dccb-, in-stcb-, in-dist-, in-state-. No score.

tools.name: rbi_supervisory_tape
tools.description: Latest RBI enforcement and supervisory actions (penalties, licence cancellations, directions) from rbi.org.in press releases, newest first, each with its source URL. A missing snapshot is stated, never silent emptiness.

tools.name: research_network
tools.description: Route to Palimpsest sources, Seiche funding, Undertow exit liquidity and NarcoScope data. Set limit for full metadata. Rights remain attached; no identity, score or eligibility changes.

tools.name: stablecoin_rails_board
tools.description: Paged peg/run evidence; partial data is never CALM. Follow pagination.next_offset. Full receipts on REST. Display-only, not investment advice.

tools.name: universe_search
tools.description: Search the RBI NBFC register. Supply q or a filter; a filter without q browses that slice. Registration does not establish creditworthiness.

tools.name: verify_published_record
tools.description: Recomputes a ledger stream's hash-chain commitments and checks enabled signatures and anchors; returns the actual verdict, failures included. Verifies record integrity, not economic accuracy.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto_regime_board · Private data: evidence_europe, institution_evidence_monitor, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: crypto_exposure_board, stablecoin_rails_board.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto_regime_board · Private data: evidence_europe, institution_evidence_monitor, verify_published_record · Public sink: forward_odds · Destructive: crypto_exposure_board, stablecoin_rails_board

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
